note: Rules for sentences the agent writes in its own words (docs/T-DESIGN.md). Written by the planning chat; no session edits this file. Entries are whole words or phrases, any letter case; an entry ending in * matches any word that starts with it. number_words and month_names are read from config/reply_rules.json, not repeated here.
fallback_line: I can't answer that without running a count. Tell me what to count and for which period, and I'll show you the numbers.

rewrite_hints.WORD: In a sentence that holds a slot use only plain joining words. Put anything else in its own sentence without a slot.
rewrite_hints.GLUE: Put each slot in its own sentence, or join two slots with and, exactly as given.
rewrite_hints.SLOT: Use only the slots you were given, each once, written exactly as given.
rewrite_hints.CHARS: Use only letters and plain punctuation.
rewrite_hints.NUMBER: Write no number, month or year yourself. A figure may only come from a slot. In talk, point at a figure with the words "the figure I gave" and write no number.
rewrite_hints.LABEL: Do not name a group or a place in your own words.
rewrite_hints.CLAIM: Do not explain, compare or judge the figures in your own words.
rewrite_hints.JUDGE: Do not judge the figures in your own words. Leave that sentence out or keep it neutral.
rewrite_hints.ORDER: Keep a count slot and its months or groups slot next to each other.
rewrite_hints.SHAPE: Shorter, on one line: fewer sentences.
rewrite_hints.REASON: Say why the possibility is plausible (your reasoning), and what records would be needed to check it.
rewrite_hints.MAKER: Say what you run on only in the exact words of the About you line, and say nothing else about who built you: the facts of describe_data say that.
